protocol.null_unit: task bundle (y, success_by_mode, cost_by_mode) permuted against X
protocol.cost_unit: seconds of wall-clock episode time (`total_latency_canonical_ms`), the occupancy a deployment pays for
protocol.excess_definition: SR(point) - fixed-frontier SR at the same mean cost; below the cheapest fixed cost the cheapest mode's SR is used
protocol.frontier_gain_definition: envelope(fixed ∪ curve points) - envelope(fixed), in SR pp, on u = (cost - cheapest fixed) / (dearest fixed - cheapest fixed)
protocol.pooled_null: per draw b, mean of the cells' gain curves, then max over u
